name: Kioxia

source.quote: Revenue increased 37% YoY to ¥2.34 trillion, while operating profit nearly doubled to ¥870 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders rose to ¥554 billion.

description: Japanese NAND flash memory maker, formerly Toshiba Memory, which runs joint factories with Sandisk.
explain: Kioxia makes the flash memory chips inside data center SSDs. Its factories in Japan are shared with Sandisk, which pays Kioxia for supply. Revenue converted from about ¥2.34 trillion at roughly ¥150 per dollar.
